name: Dr. Mossbottom
bio: The senior goblin nurse at the Lantern Clinic in Salve & Scale. Has seen every kind of thorn.

portrait.subject: a cute old goblin nurse with round spectacles, a white nurse cap, a stethoscope and a kind toothy smile
portrait.background: warm underground clinic with lantern light

request: Dr. Mossbottom, Lantern Clinic, Salve & Scale. Our patients need a friend. So do I. 🩺
hello: Marvellous! I'll send you case notes.
about: I'm Mossbottom. Forty years at the Lantern Clinic in Gloamhollow. Goblins, slimes, skeletons. Everyone deserves healing.
how: Run a clinic for monsters: greet patients, examine them, find what's wrong and treat them with the right salves and tools.
tips: Look at every symptom before you treat.
Slimes' cores change colour when they're curdled.
Hexes on bones need careful reading.
chat: A troll came in with a splinter the size of a log.
A skeleton asked for a bone density check. Funny guy.
Made a salve that smells like peppermint. Patients love it.
A slime hugged me after treatment. I'm still sticky.
nudge: The waiting room is full! Come help?
An interesting case just arrived. Want a look?
idle: The clinic's been without you for {ago}. Patients are waiting!
{ago}! A goblin's been holding his foot this whole time.
progress: Day {day} at the clinic! Gloamhollow is healthier for it.

questions.q: Which patient would you treat first?

update: Clinic memo: Salve & Scale is now v{version}!
